title: Senior Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
Job Description

**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

The Senior Customer Success Data Analyst owns how Customer Success uses data to improve adoption, retention, drive expansion and decide where CSMs focus.

You will own the CS analytics strategy, metric framework, customer health score and churn-prediction approach, and act as the analytics partner to the Head of CS Operations and CS leadership. As the team is new, you will design how data from various platforms, databases and raw Excel dumps in Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk and product telemetry comes together, and set the standard for how we use analytics and AI across Customer Success.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

**CS analytics strategy**

* Own the CS analytics roadmap with the Head of CS Operations, prioritizing work by impact on retention and growth.
* Act as the trusted analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping decisions on segmentation, coverage models and customer playbooks.
* Present insights to CS leadership and contribute to board-level reporting.

**Customer health and churn prediction**

* Own the customer health score methodology end to end — design, validation against actual renewal and churn outcomes, and regular recalibration.
* Build predictive churn and propensity models (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis) and turn them into early-warning signals CSMs can act on.
* Compare retention and outcomes across customer groups (industry, region, account segments, products, sign-up period) to uncover what drives churn and growth.
* Lead root-cause analysis of churn and downsell.

**Metrics, dashboards and reporting**

* Define and govern the CS metric framework and a single source of truth so CS, Sales, Finance and Product report the same numbers and details.
* Own reporting on core CS KRAs — Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR/NRR), other renewal and growth details, time-to-value, adoption and health distribution.
* Oversee dashboards in Excel, presentations and Power BI for CS leadership and CSMs.
* Lead data and meeting preparation for internal monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and leadership/board reporting.

**Product usage, renewals and expansion**

* Partner with Product and Engineering to model product telemetry for adoption and value-realization metrics.
* Own risk-weighted renewal forecasting, so leadership sees a realistic outlook and CSMs know which renewals need attention.
* Analyze feature adoption, usage depth and breadth, and onboarding milestones to identify at-risk and high-potential accounts.
* Build models that identify upsell and cross-sell signals from usage, license utilization, account health and intelligence, and share them with CSMs.
* Measure the impact of CS programs and plays on retention and expansion revenue.

**Data foundations**

* Set data-quality and governance standards for CRM and CS-platform data, and drive fixes with system owners
* Design the CS data model and integrations across Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk, internal deployment tools and product data.
* Document metrics, data sources and processes so analytics can scale with the team.

**AI-enabled analytics**

* Use LLMs such as Claude hands-on to accelerate building modules, analysis of data, querying data, documentation and insight generation.
* Design and roll out AI-assisted workflows and agents for CS — e.g. account summaries, sentiment analysis, renewal-risk briefs etc.
* Set guidelines for responsible, secure use of AI with customer data, in line with Seclore's data-protection standards.

**Your first 90 days:**

First 30 days

* Understand our customers, products and CS motion; assess data sources across various tools like Salesforce, Statisfy, product telemetry etc.
* Deliver a gap assessment of data quality.
* Deliver a baseline view of retention and renewals.

By 60 days

* Get the CS metric definition and framework agreed across CS and Finance.
* Launch the first version of CS leadership dashboard.
* Present the health-score framework and churn-model design.

By 90 days

* Launch V1 of the health score.
* Deliver a risk-weighted renewal forecast framework to CSMs for regular use.
* Publish a prioritized CS analytics roadmap.

**How we will measure impact over time:** Predictive accuracy of the health score and churn models, use of insights in leadership and CSM decisions, data-quality improvements in CRM/CS platforms, and measurable contribution to GRR, NRR and adoption.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, with at least 2–3 years in customer success, revenue or business operations analytics, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Proven track record of building customer health scores or churn models end to end and getting them adopted by CS teams.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python for data wrangling, statistical analysis and predictive modeling (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis).
* Expert-level dashboard building in Power BI and Excel.
* Deep experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) data — accounts, opportunities, renewals.
* Hands-on experience administering or configuring a customer success platform such as Statisfy, Gainsight, Totango or ChurnZero.
* Experience designing data models and working with data from multiple systems and raw sources.
* Strong command of SaaS and subscription metrics: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, renewal rate, adoption.
* Advanced, hands-on AI user with experience applying LLMs such as Claude to analysis, coding, automation and documentation.
* A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions with data and clear storytelling.
* A builder mindset and comfort creating structure, standards and processes where none exist yet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in cybersecurity, data security or another enterprise B2B technology domain.
* Experience leading small analytics projects or teams.
* Experience helping build a CS Ops function from scratch.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience building AI agents or automated workflows for business teams.
* Exposure to customer segmentation and CS coverage-model design.

**Who you will work with:**

You will work closely with CSMs, Solution Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Consultants, and Sales to monitor account health, identify risks, generate renewal and expansion insights, support renewal forecasting, manage expansion pipelines, and maintain shared CRM data standards. You will partner with Product and Engineering to leverage usage telemetry, drive adoption insights, and establish product feedback loops. You will also collaborate with Finance and Leadership on ARR, GRR, NRR, and retention reporting for business and board reviews.

**Why join us**

* Be the senior analytics voice in a new CS Operations team and shape how Customer Success uses data.
* High visibility, with direct exposure to CS, Sales, Product and Finance leadership decisions.
* Work on meaningful problems for global enterprise customers in data security.
* Hands-on use of modern analytics and AI tools, with room to experiment.

**How to apply**

Complete the Microsoft Form.

After submitting the form, continue and submit your application on our **Careers page**.

 **Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Requirements Engineering**

* Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
* Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
* Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
* Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
* Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

**Domain coverage**

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

* Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
* Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
* Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
* Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
* Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
* PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

**Agentic AI specifics**

* Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
* Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
* Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
* Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
* Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

**Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance**

* Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
  + 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
  + GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
  + GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
  + Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
  + Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  + Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
* Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

**Stakeholder and delivery**

* Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
* Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
* Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
* Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

  
**Qualifications**

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
* 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
* Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
* Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
* Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
* Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.

**Preferred**

* Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.

**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Credit Risk Review (CRR)**
==================================


**Credit Risk Review** (CRR) provides independent, objective, reliable, valued, and timely assurance to the Board of Directors, Risk Committees, the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer, the Citigroup Chief Credit Officer, senior management, and global regulators. CRR evaluates the effectiveness of credit and collateral risk management, assessing the ability of business units and independent Risk Management to identify, monitor, and mitigate current and emerging credit risks.


**Role Overview**
=================


As a key member of the **CRR Analytics Team**, you will provide critical data analytics and credit risk analyst support to Lead Reviewers. This role is instrumental in managing ongoing portfolio monitoring and credit reviews, identifying thematic risk trends, and evaluating emerging risks. You will collaborate closely with reviewers to assign portfolios, establish sample coverages, and participate actively in review activities, while also supporting broader data\-driven credit risk projects across the CRR group.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


* **Credit \& Exposure Assessment**: Evaluate the integrity and accuracy of credit analyses, exposure calculations, risk rating methodologies, and asset classifications for monitored and reviewed relationships to ensure alignment with institutional policies and standards.
* **Credit Assessment Documentation**: Partner with Lead Reviewers to draft comprehensive Credit Assessment Documents, integrating advanced credit and data analytics to quantify thematic risks or substantiate a portfolio's stable outlook ("good bill of health").
* **Assistant to the Lead Reviewer:** Serve as a strategic analytical partner to Lead Reviewers, translating qualitative observations and risk hypotheses into rigorous, data\-backed evidence. Maintain a deep understanding of credit policies and data structures to track the end\-to\-end credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting standards, limit utilization, covenant compliance, and workout/remediation processes.
* **AI \& Analytics Innovation**: Leverage advanced AI and machine learning tools to streamline data extraction, identify thematic trends across diverse portfolios, and proactively flag emerging risk indicators.
* **Stakeholder Communication**: Synthesize complex analytical findings and present clear, concise conclusions and recommendations to Lead Reviewers and senior risk management.
* **Reporting \& Regulatory Presentations:** Assist in preparing high\-quality presentations and reporting materials to support internal governance committees and regulatory examinations.

**Qualifications**
==================


* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of credit analysis or credit risk management experience within a global financial institution or banking environment.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Formal credit training or a deep understanding of financial accounting standards and credit analysis methodologies.
* **Corporate/FI Analysis:** Prior experience assessing the creditworthiness and financial strength of Corporates and Financial Institutions is highly advantageous.
* **Digital Literacy:** High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and a strong aptitude for adopting AI\-enabled productivity and data analytics tools in compliance with organizational policies. Knowledge of Python is highly advantageous.

* **Execution Skills:** Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables.
* **Communication:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex risk concepts clearly and concisely to various levels of management.

**Education**
=============


* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BSc) in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
